title: Planning data serialization
responsibility: Serialize planning records consistently, hash content and create coded failures.

inputs.name: planData.value
inputs.unknownReason: The planning serializer accepts values of arbitrary JSON-compatible shape.

inputs.name: hash.value
inputs.description: Text or bytes to hash with SHA-256.

inputs.name: PlanningError.constructor.code
inputs.description: Stable planning failure code that callers read from the thrown error; it is stored unchanged as the code property.

inputs.name: PlanningError.constructor.message
inputs.description: Human-readable failure message, used unchanged as the Error message.

inputs.name: json.value
inputs.description: JSON-compatible value to serialize with a trailing newline.
inputs.unknownReason: The formatter accepts values of arbitrary JSON-compatible shape.

outputs.name: planData
outputs.description: Serialized value with sorted object keys, omitted undefined object properties and preserved array order.

outputs.name: fail
outputs.description: Never returns; throws a PlanningError carrying code and path null.

outputs.name: json
outputs.description: Serialized record followed by a newline.

outputs.name: now
outputs.description: Current time as an ISO timestamp.

outputs.name: parse
outputs.description: Parsed JSON cast to the requested type; no schema validation is performed.

errors.name: PlanningError
errors.description: A PlanningError (an Error subclass, not an ExpectedCliError): fail throws one with the supplied code and message and path null on every call, and parse throws one with code artifact-corrupt and message Invalid artifact JSON when the bytes are not valid JSON.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Thrown by JSON.stringify when the value contains a bigint.

errors.name: RangeError
errors.description: Thrown when the value contains a circular reference: planData recurses into every array and object, so a cycle overflows the call stack.

errors.name: PlanningError
errors.description: parse replaces any JSON parse failure with the PlanningError from fail whose code is artifact-corrupt, message is Invalid artifact JSON and path is null.
